patch.description: Saves a batch of `values` atomically. Each key is validated against its type and range (`details[].field` = `values.<key>`). Changing a sensitive key (platform_fee_percent, pack_fee_percent, invoice_issuer, maintenance_mode) without `confirm: true` returns 409 `SETTINGS_CONFIRM_REQUIRED` with `details.diff: SettingDiffDto[]` (every change) and `details.sensitiveKeys`: show the confirm dialog, then resend with `confirm: true`. Send `expectedUpdatedAt` (key → loaded `updatedAt`) for optimistic concurrency: 409 `STALE_UPDATE` with `details.keys`. Unchanged values are ignored; every save writes one `settings.updated` activity log entry (level sensitive). Returns all settings. Used by SET-01.

info.title: Eventor Admin API
info.description:
Admin API for the Eventor event-services marketplace.

- Routes are private by default: send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Public routes say so.
- Single objects return `{ data }`; lists return `{ data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.
- Errors return `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details, path, timestamp, requestId }`; `message` follows `Accept-Language` (en | ar), `code` is stable.
- Money is a string with 2 decimals in DZD.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE code clients switch on.

details.description: Extra data for the code. For VALIDATION_FAILED: an array of `{ field, code, message }`.

maxLength.description: Max string length or list size.

sensitive.description: Changing it needs `confirm: true` (SET-01 confirm dialog).

sections.description: Every section, in screen order (`notifications` has no keys yet).

values.description: Setting key → new value. Each value is checked against its type and range.

confirm.description: Required when a sensitive setting changes.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Key → the `updatedAt` you loaded (null if it was never saved). A mismatch returns 409 STALE_UPDATE.

avatarUrl.description: Signed, expiring URL of the avatar, or null.

remember.description: Keep the refresh cookie for 30 days instead of the browser session.

token.description: The `token` query parameter of the emailed link.

password.description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit (PASSWORD_WEAK otherwise).
At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit (PASSWORD_WEAK otherwise).

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit.

id.description: User id, or the invitation id for `invited` rows.

expiresAt.description: Invitation expiry; may be in the past (resend it).

status.description: `done` right away below 5,000 rows; otherwise `queued` and emailed when ready.

fileUrl.description: Signed download URL (expires after FILES_URL_TTL); fetch the export again for a fresh one. null until done.

filters.description: The list screen's current filters (same names as its query parameters, arrays for multi-values). Unknown filters return 400.

columns.description: Column keys, in file order. Defaults to the resource defaults.

hasChanges.description: The entry has old → new changes (see LOG-02).
The entry has old → new changes (see LOG-02).

object.description: Hint for the dashboard to link the object (route chosen client-side by `type`).

isOwner.description: I can edit and delete it.

query.description: The list query parameters (filters, sort, columns) as the dashboard stores them.

isShared.description: Visible to every admin (only the owner can change it).

descriptionEn.example: Photographers and videographers for your events.

servicesCount.description: Services in the category (any status, not deleted).

providersCount.description: Providers whose main category it is.

bookings30dCount.description: Bookings of its services created in the last 30 days.

missingTranslation.description: A name, or one of the descriptions, is missing in EN or AR.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case; generated from `nameEn` when omitted.

nameEn.description: EN and AR names: at least one; an empty one shows "Missing translation".

descriptionEn.example: Photographers and videographers for your events.

icon.description: Icon name from the dashboard icon set (kebab-case).

isVisible.description: Shown in app. Hidden categories are not selectable for new services.

ids.description: Category ids in their new order. May be the whole list or one tab: the ids take the position slots they already occupy.

providersCount.description: Providers serving this wilaya (their default area).

servicesCount.description: Published services offered in this wilaya (hidden from search when it is closed).

bookingsCount.description: Bookings at this commune; a commune in use cannot be deleted.

name.description: Unique in the wilaya (case- and accent-insensitive).

line.description: Line in the file (the header is line 1).

updated.description: Existing communes whose Arabic name or postal code changed.

skipped.description: Rows identical to an existing commune.

bookingsCount.description: Bookings of any status, as client or as provider.

earnings.description: DZD. Sum of completed booking totals (earned by a provider, spent by a client).

body.example: Called about a late cancellation; will monitor.

canDelete.description: Only the author can delete a note.

bookingsCount.description: Bookings of any status, as client or as provider.

role.description: Immutable afterwards. Admins are invited from SET-05.

skipVerification.description: Providers: mark as verified without documents.

phone.description: Changing it requires `reason`; null removes it.

reason.example: The user asked by phone to change their email.

typedName.description: The account's full name, typed to confirm (case-insensitive).

conversations.description: Open conversations that become read-only for the user.

reason.description: Reason code or short label shown in the banner.

until.description: Automatic unblock time (future); omit for indefinite.

message.example: Your account was blocked after several reports.

temporaryPassword.description: Only for `temporary`; shown once, never stored in clear.

body.example: Called about a late cancellation; will monitor.

previous.description: Older versions, newest first (the previous decision).

position.description: 1-based position in the queue; null when the provider is not in it.

message.example: The photo is blurry; please upload a sharper scan of both sides.
